meta.purpose: Canonical machine-owned queue for Truck_Opti launch normalization.
notes: Keep at most two active tasks.
Use proof-driven validation on every task.
Treat live credential blockers explicitly instead of hiding them inside generic launch work.

tasks.title: Add the sellable product contract artifact
tasks.why: TruckOpti is being carried as a sellable near-launch product, but the repo still lacks an accepted contract artifact that ties the live launch slice to one owned surface.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Truck_Opti has an accepted product contract artifact and the launch, task, and handoff surfaces all point at the same sellable-product slice.
validation: Run 0.dev-matrix/sync-two-task-loop.ps1 -Mode manual and confirm the active pair points at the live sellable-product slice.
tasks.businessValue: Turns TruckOpti's launch claims into contract-backed commercial readiness instead of implied product scope.

tasks.title: Prepare the post-credentials launch proof surface
tasks.why: The remaining hard blocker is live Razorpay credentials, so the repo needs an explicit proof path that can be run immediately once those credentials exist.
tasks.definitionOfDone: TruckOpti names the exact post-credential validation sequence for launch readiness, live auth proof, and production configuration proof.
tasks.businessValue: Removes ambiguity between a configuration blocker and the proof steps needed to convert TruckOpti into a live sellable product.

tasks.title: Provision live Razorpay credentials for launch
tasks.why: TruckOpti's current blocker is not another code refactor. It is the absence of live Razorpay production credentials in the target environment.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Production Razorpay credentials are present in the live environment and the repo can proceed to launch proof without pretending the blocker is solved in code.
tasks.businessValue: Unblocks the only hard production launch blocker currently recorded for TruckOpti.

tasks.title: Verify controlled live checkout proof
tasks.why: Live Razorpay keys, GST-disabled billing, and the production checkout bundle are already deployed. The remaining payment-side launch proof is one controlled authenticated checkout that reaches the server-side verify-razorpay-payment path on the live site.
tasks.definitionOfDone: One controlled authenticated live checkout on https://www.truckopti.in reaches the server-side verify-razorpay-payment path with GST disabled and the outcome is captured in the launch surfaces.
validation: Run one controlled authenticated checkout on https://www.truckopti.in and confirm the verify-razorpay-payment path completes.
tasks.businessValue: Turns production payment readiness from config-only confidence into revenue-grade proof.

tasks.title: Retest returning-user stale-client recovery
tasks.why: The old stale checkout/UI problem was traced to a cached service worker on the public host and mitigated with sw-v2.js plus corrected origin cache headers. Launch proof still needs one returning-user/browser-cache retest against the new service-worker path.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A returning-user retest confirms the live app updates onto the sw-v2.js path without stale chunk failures or old checkout payment-logo regressions, and the proof is captured in the launch surfaces.
validation: Open a returning-user/browser-cache path on https://www.truckopti.in and confirm the live checkout renders the new payment badges with no stale chunk failures.
tasks.businessValue: Reduces launch risk for returning users by proving stale-client recovery on the live host rather than only in code or origin headers.

tasks.title: Capture normalized TruckOpti launch evidence
tasks.why: The repo should finish the launch slice with explicit proof and aligned handoff surfaces once the live checkout proof and stale-client retest are captured.
tasks.definitionOfDone: TruckOpti handoff, state, task board, and closeout all reflect the same validated live payment and stale-client launch evidence.
validation: Run 0.dev-matrix/sync-two-task-loop.ps1 -Mode manual after the proof files are updated.
tasks.businessValue: Locks launch readiness into durable proof that sales and delivery work can trust.
